Pricing and availability

Every plan on this fixture page is billed monthly and can be cancelled from the account screen at any time, which is the lead paragraph a snippet would normally quote. Nested annotation that must not be counted twice.

What does the starter plan include?

The starter plan includes two seats, ten projects and the shared audit queue. It is the cheapest tier and it is the one most small teams pick when they begin using the product.

Prices shown exclude tax. This block is annotated because the legal team asked for it and it is not part of the answer a search engine should quote from this page.

How do refunds work?

Refunds are processed within ten business days of the request and are returned to the original payment method, minus any transaction fee charged by the payment processor.
